about: Attack-arc wave 6, ancestral druid forms. Measured 2026-11-15 from assets/models/form_alpha.glb (md5 e5b97c66) and form_ent.glb (md5 b0040693), identical in master and wt/post-int. Pure-Python glTF reader (scratchpad meas.py), rigid pieces on bone nodes, 24 fps, frames 1-based, model space: x = +X of the model, y up, z forward, metres BEFORE FORM_SCALE (alpha 1.4, ent 1.2). tip = front-most vertex (alpha pieces) / lowest vertex (ent pieces) of the piece in idle frame 1.
